how: Named by hand on 2026-10-05 (user, French titles; English renders translated) on the refit of run 20261001 rebuilt in place (Chess Puzzles excluded, Epoch's truncation-prone runs dropped) with the effort means as the default. The posterior splits into four modes: the best is chain 3 alone (mode A); B (chains 1, 5, 6) sits 84 nats lower, C (0, 4, 7) 87 and D (2) 135. The figures carry mode A, reference-aligned; the top benchmarks below are mode A's by share of their loading variance. The axes of modes C and D read the same way, mode B's third axis does not (agentic SWE rather than cyber). A title is applied only while one of its signature benchmarks stays among the axis's top benchmarks by share.
